_note: Autofocus for MINERVA's T1 and T2 (CDK700s; docs/autofocus.md). Merge each 'telescopes' entry into the enclosure config's entry of the same name (aqawan1.json) and add 'autofocus_triggers' at its top level.
The focuser addresses are 127.0.0.1 placeholders (PWI's port focuser through ASCOM Remote).

Values from minerva-control's config (sites/minerva/README.md has the table): T1 imager_t1.ini (Andor DW936N, 0.61 arcsec/px: 13.5 um pixels at the 4560 mm focal length); T2 imager_t2.ini (Apogee Aspen CG230, 0.679 arcsec/px: 15 um pixels); fau_t1.ini, fau_t2.ini (ZWO ASI174, 0.265 arcsec/px, 5.86 um pixels).

telescope_1.ini: imager on M3 port 1, FAU on port 2, MINFOCUS 455 (port 1) and 100 (port 2), MAXFOCUS 33000. telescope_2.ini: imager on port 2, FAU on port 1, MINFOCUS 100, MAXFOCUS 33000. The focus is in microns (um_per_step 1). The ports are named 'imager' and 'fau' here.
f/6.5 (700 mm, 4560 mm); the CDK700 focusers move the instrument (focal_plane_factor 1). The obstruction is a placeholder until measured; the calibration's slope checks it.
Saturation: legacy SATURATION is 60000 for every camera; 55000 here keeps the measured stars below the non-linear top.

model: the legacy focus model's temperature term (C0 per C about T0, on the primary's temperature; T1: -29.1 about 10.089 C, T2: -52.94 about 8.95 C); here on the focuser's temperature until the primary's is in the registry. The delta-T and gravity terms (instruments.json) wait for those values. Its zero point is learned from each successful autofocus (store).
max_start_error: the legacy guesses were 130-600 um off on 2026-04-23 (T2). Backlash is not known: measure it (0 here).
Run a calibration sweep ({"kind": "autofocus", "autofocus": {"calibrate": true}}) once per port and filter before relying on the V-curve.
